step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: 71-year-old female with eosinophilic pustular folliculitis

evidence_items.source_quote: HIV and syphilis testing were negative, ruling out these infectious causes.

rationale: A 71-year-old female with eosinophilic pustular folliculitis; syphilis testing was negative.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: 31-year-old male with anti-NF155 autoimmune nodopathy

evidence_items.source_quote: and a full infectious panel (hepatitis B and C, syphilis, HIV) returned within normal range or negative results.

rationale: A 31-year-old male with anti-NF155 autoimmune nodopathy; infectious panel including syphilis was negative.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: 74-year-old male with malignant pleural mesothelioma and checkpoint inhibitor-induced irAEs

evidence_items.source_quote: The FilmArray CSF panel was negative, and serological tests for syphilis and HIV were also negative.

rationale: A 74-year-old male with malignant pleural mesothelioma and ICI-induced autoimmune encephalitis; serological testing for syphilis was negative.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: Mid-40s female with pembrolizumab-associated bilateral branch retinal artery occlusions

evidence_items.source_quote: Infectious (Tuberculosis, Syphilis), hypercoagulability, and inflammatory workup (erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive protein, human leukocyte antigen B27, angiotensin-converting enzyme, lysozyme, antinuclear antibody) were also negative.

rationale: A mid-40s female with pembrolizumab-associated BRAOs; infectious workup for syphilis was negative.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: 19-year-old female with postpartum uterine and pulmonary echinococcosis

evidence_items.source_quote: Routine antenatal serology revealed HIV-negative, rhesus-positive and syphilis-negative results.

rationale: A 19-year-old female with postpartum echinococcosis; routine antenatal serology was syphilis-negative.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: 39-year-old male with relapsing polychondritis and anti-GABABR limbic encephalitis

rationale: A 39-year-old male with relapsing polychondritis and anti-GABABR limbic encephalitis; serological testing excluded syphilis.
